messages:
alex singh: Heads-up: planning an infra change during tonight's release window (23:00 UTC). Terraform changes to IAM role trust for cross-account VPC peering. Deploy-bot will run preflight. Need ack from net + security.

priya nambiar: ack. can we split into two applies? create the role in acct-A, then attach policies in acct-B after peering is up?

jon wells: prefer 3-step: create peering (request/accept), create role, attach policies + route updates. peering acceptance can have a short replication lag (~2-5m).

maya chen: security note: require KMS key policy review. when changing trust, add condition on aws:SourceAccount or aws:SourceVpc. send the diff here.

alex singh: i'll pin provider and module versions in the plan (no surprises). deploy-bot, kick preflight and post terraform plan here.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Preflight started for branch release/2026-03-20. Running `terraform init && terraform plan -out=preflight.tfplan` in infra/networking...

deploy-bot: plan snippet:
```
+ aws_vpc_peering_connection.peer (new)
+ aws_iam_role.peering_role (new)
+ aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.peering_attach (new)
~ aws_route.peer_route (changed)
```

priya nambiar: plan looks sane. one comment: avoid global/static role names. use pattern: redwood-peering-${account_id}-${env}. also, what's the rollback plan if peering acceptance fails?

alex singh: rollback plan: 1) revert route changes, 2) remove peering acceptance (if created), 3) revert IAM trust to previous commit. i'll paste exact commands before prod. requesting +15m extension on change window just in case.

ops-bot: Notice: change window scheduled 23:00-00:30 UTC. alex singh requested extension to 00:45 UTC. Approve? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maya chen: approved from security. ensure cloudtrail alerts for PutRolePolicy and UpdateAssumeRolePolicy are enabled and sent to SIEM.

jon wells: i'll be on-call for peering acceptance and routing propagation. ping me before prod apply. :phone: 

alex singh: doing a canary apply in staging now. will post plan output + state lock info. pinned terraform state tag: v2026-03-18.

deploy-bot: apply started in staging (workspace: staging). Logs:
---
Applying: aws_vpc_peering_connection.peer
Apply complete: resources added: 2
No error messages.
---

alex singh: staging green. scheduling prod apply in 10m. note: if prod errors with EntityAlreadyExists for the role, we will import the existing resource then reapply.

priya nambiar: noted. i'll monitor infra metrics and health dashboards during apply. if latency spikes, we abort and roll back.

deploy-bot: prod apply initiated. state lock acquired: s3://redwood-terraform-locks/network/lock.json
Plan summary: +2 resources, changed: 1

deploy-bot: Warning: IAM assume role updated for aws_iam_role.peering_role. Running policy simulator checks... PASSED.

alex singh: prod apply succeeded. peering accepted and routes updated. confirm route propagation across AZs and accounts. great work :rocket: 

jon wells: checked routes. propagation completed in ~4m, no route drift.

maya chen: KMS policy change confirmed and logged to SIEM. no suspicious activity.

priya nambiar: closing window early at 00:20 UTC since everything looks stable. release notes: change-id RINF-342, role version v1.2.0 (pinned), provider aws v4.60.0. rollback instructions added to ops runbook.

alex singh: i'll update the release notes and attach the plan artifact: https://artifacts.internal/release/2101234567/plan.txt

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: tagging release artifacts and unlocking state. :white_check_mark:
